review_evidence: README identifies CatCrypt Core as machine-checked foundations for game-based cryptographic security in Lean: sub-distributions, probabilistic/stateful computation, pRHL, package algebra, category structure, proof automation, cryptographic assumptions, forking lemmas and curve mathematics.

The 238 non-document/build primary modules include probability, core semantics, relational/unary/nonuniform logics, packages, categories, deep/shallow bridges, tactics, crypto assumptions and many worked protocol examples.

Complete inspection of docs/CoreManual.lean found one Verso #doc narrative/manual command with transcribed code snippets but no owned formal mathematical declaration/proof; docs/ManualMain.lean contains only documentation-renderer/navigation configuration; docs/lakefile.lean and root lakefile.lean contain only Lake package/target/dependency configuration. The source checkout preserves all four for auxiliary documentation/provenance.
